Unsplash, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. The colours, type steps, radii and spacing were read from unsplash.com on 2026-11-19, signed out, in the T3 preview browser. The header toggle sets data-mode. Unsplash itself switches with a .light or .dark class. The signed-out pages stayed on light. Dark values come from a detached .dark node.

The preview browser returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames", so this guide has no page captures beside it. The system face is ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif. No web font was declared.

Colour

Ink is #111111. The page is white. Muted type is #767676. The search pill is #eeeeee. The primary button is the same ink, with white type.
